extends.rule: every X0 term keeps its exact v1 definition; v1 stays byte-identical; the terms below are ADDED (no X0 term is redefined)

scope: crypto / Binance Spot / long-only, marketable (taker) orders; research only (paper-only program, no orders, no credentials)

terms.definition: (ask - bid) / mid * 1e4 of the PIT book state at a timestamp: a MEASURED/DERIVED market-structure observation. It is NOT a forecast of a future realized cost and is never joined to returns in P2-X1.

the cost actually paid by a real order (fill price vs reference, commissions, partial fills). UNAVAILABLE: no order is ever sent; it needs the actual-fill calibration path (reconciliation_design_v2.json).
t = T + scenario latency at which a scenario reads market state. A research instant, NOT an observed order time.
a declared research sensitivity value of the decision-to-fill delay (0 / 1 / 5 s). ASSUMED; it is not an observed order latency and is never presented as one.

t1 - t0 of the collector's public market-data REST probe (/api/v3/time on the public market-data host) from this host: a MEASURED lower-bound observation of network round trip to a public endpoint; it does not measure order entry, matching, acknowledgement or fill reporting.
t - observed_at_ms of the PIT-selected book record (X0 definition, unchanged). For a persisted boundary S: S - observed_at_ms (sample-and-hold age).
t - observed_at_ms of the PIT-selected depth snapshot.
the PIT-selected book record has sample_ms >= t: the collector had already confirmed that no newer quote was received up to t, so the record is exactly the latest received quote at t.

otherwise: the selected record is the latest PERSISTED quote; quotes received in (last boundary, t] and superseded before the next boundary were never persisted; the unobserved window is confirmation_gap_ms.

the volume-weighted price of walking the displayed levels of one sampled depth snapshot for a declared notional (X0-S2 / X1-S2). A lower bound on the cost of consuming displayed liquidity at the snapshot instant; NOT market impact, NOT realized slippage.
an estimate whose fill is UNAVAILABLE (book or depth INVALID, or the notional exceeds displayed depth): reported with its reason and counted; never replaced by a fallback or extrapolation.

for each field of a P2-X leg: STATIC (inputs / contract / identity known before T), DECISION (market state available at or before T), EXECUTION (state available only at or before T + latency: post-decision, label side only), UNAVAILABLE_BY_DESIGN (never computed in a leg), REFERENCE (an opaque content id usable only as a join key). See result_schema_v2.json.

truth_boundary.statement: P2-X reconstructs touch (top-of-book) and displayed-book-consumption scenarios from sampled public market data, but it cannot measure actual market impact, realized slippage, fill probability, queue position or realized execution cost: no order is ever submitted, so there are no acknowledgements, fills, partial fills or commissions, and the data carry no trade prints and no exchange event time on book or depth.
truth_boundary.consequence: every slippage value is ESTIMATED (displayed-depth walk) or ASSUMED (fixed sensitivity); market impact and adverse selection stay UNAVAILABLE; nothing is ever labelled realized

provenance_classes: unchanged from X0-TERMS 1.0.0 (MEASURED, DERIVED, ESTIMATED, ASSUMED, UNAVAILABLE; a composite takes the weakest); ASSUMED is never presented as MEASURED
